# Zana-G — Genesis "Zeno" Montilla

> Remote web developer and designer based in Mindanao, Philippines (GMT+8). Builds WordPress/Elementor websites, Shopify stores, React/Next.js apps and AI automations (n8n, MCP, Claude) for agencies, startups and small businesses in the US, UK, Australia, Singapore and Germany.

DRAFT: Zeno to review before uploading to https://zana-g.com/llms.txt

## Services
- WordPress & Elementor: custom pages, full site builds, fixes, WooCommerce, Gutenberg
- Shopify: theme customization, custom Liquid sections, apps, bundles, Printful, 3D/360° product viewers
- Full-stack: React, Next.js, TypeScript, REST/GraphQL APIs, Vercel
- AI & automation: n8n workflows, AI agents, MCP, Claude Code, lead routing and AI-drafted replies
- Technical SEO: schema (JSON-LD), llms.txt and AI-crawler readiness, Core Web Vitals, Search Console
- Tracking: GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, booking and form conversion tracking
- Hosting & ops: cPanel, DNS, domains, staging, migrations, maintenance
